content: आग्रहारिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [अग्रहार-ठञ्; see आग्रभोजनिक] One who appropriates to himself an अग्रहार (endowments of land conferred upon Brāhmaṇas). Supervisor of Agrahāra lands, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} lands offered as free gifts to Brāhmaṇas for their subsistence or settlement therein or for some religious purposes.
